reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Chart: Add `global.image.registry`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: A new optional Helm value global.image.registry was added; no operational consequence is stated for operators.

proposed.statement: A new Helm value global.image.registry (default "registry.k8s.io") was added to the chart; it adds an option and has no operational consequence by itself.
